rationale: Evelyn convenes vertical AI founders and advises on design partner strategy—a core challenge Elias faces as an AI/ML builder shipping consumer and infrastructure products. While Elias is rooted in fast-moving AI/ML tooling (LanceDB, multimodal vector databases, terminal-first environments), Evelyn's conviction that founders must uncover hidden demand before building and validate with 5–10 design partners maps directly to how Elias could stress-test Lee-AI and future products with enterprise collaborators rather than building in isolation.
intro_message: Evelyn Rodriguez, meet Elias Schwalme—Evelyn advises vertical AI founders on design partner selection and validation cadence, and Elias is shipping AI products and building ML infrastructure; you two should compare notes on moving from rapid prototyping into structured market validation.
